title: Asymptote fix, lists, one-var stats and regression

features.notes: Break the curve where consecutive samples jump across a vertical asymptote: sign change with huge magnitude, or the y-range exceeding the window by far. Do the detection server-side in plot (null at the break), or client-side in the canvas draw loop, or both. A steep continuous curve such as 10*x must stay whole. f1 colour stays #1f77b4. Keep the P10 plot contract intact.

Add /api/lists CRUD routes. Persist lists in the P9 state store (atomic write-through, reset empties them). Lists must be usable in the evaluator, where 2*L1+1 gives exact "[3, 5, 7]". Respect the P23/P27 grammar restrictions and the P26 rule that stored data never breaks later evaluations. Validate each value with the evaluator, so "abc+" gives 400.

Read the list from the P15 store. Use the TI quartile method (median of the lower and upper halves, leaving out the median when n is odd). Keep exact values with sympy and give decimals with 12 significant digits using the existing formatter. An empty, missing or undefined list gives 400.

Use a least-squares fit for linear and quadratic models. Coefficients and r2 are 12-significant-digit decimal strings with clean zeros ("0", not "-0" or "1e-16"). The curve has 50 points across the data x-range. Mismatched or bad input gives 400.
